name: Ratio Finance
rootCause: On December 3, 2022, Ratio Finance on Solana suffered a compromise via a developer's private key, allowing an attacker to drain collateral from a particular user's vault. Only one user was directly affected, and subsequent platform actions focused on recovery and protection. A developer's private key was compromised, enabling unauthorized access to withdraw collateral from a single user vault.
